name: track_preparer
description: Prepares music (CUE splitting, silence trim, covers, ReplayGain, multi-disc merge) for the Volumio library.
author: karkolom223

volumio_info.details: Splits CUE+image albums (also several cue files, side A/B images), trims silence, adds covers and ReplayGain, merges multi-disc albums and sorts them by tags.
volumio_info.changelog: 1.8.1: ReplayGain sanity checks (implausible 0 LUFS rejected, tags verified after writing), end-to-end self-test with embedded cover
